predicates.title: Management or database port reachable from the internet
predicates.description: A public IP's effective NSG allows inbound traffic from the internet to a management (RDP/SSH/WinRM) or database port, exposing a brute-force / exploitation entry point.
predicates.attack_vector: Internet-exposed management surface -> brute force / exploit -> initial access
predicates.recommendation: Restrict to known source ranges, use Bastion/Just-In-Time access, and remove public exposure. Cross-ref network-exposure.

predicates.title: Unaddressed Microsoft Defender EASM high-priority observation
predicates.description: A Microsoft Defender EASM workspace reports an open high- or medium-priority observation (expired certs, vulnerable services, exposed assets) that remains unaddressed.
predicates.recommendation: Triage and remediate Defender EASM observations; assign owners to discovered assets.

predicates.title: Orphaned public IP address
predicates.description: A public IP address is allocated but not associated with any resource (no ipConfiguration), enlarging the surface and risking reuse/confusion or takeover of DNS records pointing at it.
predicates.attack_vector: Stale/orphaned address -> confusion, potential takeover of DNS pointing at it
predicates.recommendation: Release unattached public IPs; ensure DNS records do not reference them.

query.kql: Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, ipConfigurationId=tostring(properties.ipConfiguration.id)
